list: the official 55 trophies — Leonida Legend guide

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no multiplayer or DLC requirement — everything is single-player. Work through the roadmap in order: finish the story, do the one possibly missable meditation early, clear the stranger strands and side characters, then grind the activities, collectibles and money goals, and finish the 100% checklist for A Long Road. The platinum is the last trophy you will earn.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold trophy and the real endgame grind. The 100% checklist only becomes visible after the story (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), but progress you make during the story already counts. Nothing toward 100% is missable, and everything can be finished in free-roam after the story. The list is forgiving — it is closer to 60% true completion. You need: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges, all drone races, all of Bret's quests, 15 target decks, and 15 of 18 meditations. Each meditation done with both Jason and Lucia counts double. Finish the checklist and this gold pops, leaving only the platinum.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies

steps: Finish the story to reveal the 100% checklist
Complete 100 optional missions

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 under-the-bridge passes, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps by parachute. Mix categories — the under-the-bridge passes are the quickest to rack up. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past 250. Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts (press R3 for progress by region), and use Map, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots to see found and completed stunts by name.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY — do the Chapter 1 meditation when it appears. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditating with BOTH Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The final meditation needs both characters playable together (after Chapter 2, Coffee Break). Why possibly missable: the first meditation happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house — after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the morning and goes to the balcony. Follow her and choose Accept. That raises the counter by 1 but is NOT marked as a Meditation Spot, so whether it is required is still unconfirmed as of 19 Nov 2026 — the guide author had done it when earning the trophy. Do it to be safe, and keep a save from that point.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming a firearm — it slows time, highlights weak spots, and drains the purple focus bar (top-left, under health and stamina). You must kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in ONE use, and it only lasts seconds. Buff your focus first (eat and drink, wash your face or shower at home), consume Adrenaline to extend it (hold L1, then Triangle), line up 5 enemies (for example at a gang operation), wear body armour, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 — accurate and full-auto. It does NOT work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Focus, the purple eye icon); raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots. It gets easier late-game and often pops naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a LARGE passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — NOT the planes sitting on the airfield; it must be connected to a passenger boarding bridge. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get straight in (or walk in through the terminal). Inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off, and fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is delayed, so keep flying.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it is auto-marked from the story and teaches the first vault robbery: tail a security van to a bank, a guard carries a briefcase in, the vault opens, go in and rob it. Bring your partner and hold Right to hand off a bag — you cannot carry it all. After that, pay Yasmani (the fence, unlocked in Chapter 3) $10,000 for security van tips (purple icon; first do his earlier quests, including robbing 2 Payday Loans). Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level: escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognisable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; you need any 5 (all 8 for 100%), and a bank can pay up to $205,000 — the best endgame money.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have MAXIMUM strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time (check under the touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength — the heart icon). Only possible after Chapter 2, Coffee Break, when character switching unlocks. Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness-club membership (filter the map by Activities, the dumbbell icon; there are clubs across Vice City) — and ALWAYS go together with your partner (hold Right + Triangle to call them): while one works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you get double progress. Home workouts also work after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile (PSN tracks a count up to 500 — click the trophy in the trophy list to see it). Turn on notifications first: Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On — a demon face appears at the right of the screen when an action counts. The profiles are Professional (stealth objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating, limb shots), Violent (killing enemies or civilians), Psycho (killing many cops or civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable (permanent if you keep using excessive violence). It comes passively while doing the other trophies; if you are short at the end, farm it by running over civilians or cops — note that at Psycho or Irredeemable, cops shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 is a cumulative TOTAL, not all at once. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery (after Chapter 4, That's Where The Money Is…), so this comes naturally alongside the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shop types. The fastest way is on guns, car mods and tattoos (the most expensive items). The shop counts are: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios, and 15 electronics stores. Just buy what you need for the other trophies and this pops along the way.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (plus the 4 story garages — only the 8 purchasable ones count), for a total of $160,000. They become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — the Vice City Real Estate app then appears on your phone; buy through the app. The money comes from robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses): it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. You need enough garages first (Little Boxes — each garage adds parking spots). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray, then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles WITHOUT trackers; later (Chapter 3) you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep it low.
